notes: Ugin's [-X] with 3 loyalty: CR 606.6 (a negative loyalty cost can't be activated unless the permanent has at least that many loyalty counters) caps X at 3, so X = 4 is refused before anything is paid and loyalty stays 3. X = 3 is legal: the cost removes all 3 counters, Ugin dies to the state-based action (CR 704.5i), and the ability still resolves and exiles the red 3-drop (mana value 3 <= X).
